**Did it go well?** It was clearly the largest endurance stimulus of the period, but these summary fields cannot establish how well you paced it or how it felt.

**What stands out?** Average HR was relatively high—about 91% of your LTHR—despite modest average power. The unusually low 10 km/h average speed also suggests stops, difficult terrain, or imperfect distance/time data may be affecting the record.

**What does this mean for the next session?** Your latest Form is +7, so there is no obvious accumulated-fatigue warning. Keep the existing plan, but use your legs and breathing as the deciding check; this record alone is insufficient to justify adding or removing intensity.
